fact: The page, undated and taken at its published date of 2026-08-29, describes the Ghana Open Data Initiative as a government platform run by the National Information Technology Agency under the Ministry of Communications, with a data catalogue portal rebooted in the 2018-2019 revamp; it ties the portal to the initiative and to the draft data sharing policy, not to an adopted open data policy.

The World Bank completion report (23 Dec 2024) says the eTransform project, implemented by the Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation, built the Ghana Open Data portal, to which 315 datasets had been uploaded since 2020, but that the count had not grown for 3 years and the portal was down at the time of writing; as_of is the document date.
